jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Description

At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions to reimagine customer experiences for enterprises. We provide an end-to-end approach to help businesses overcome the complexity of digital transformation and deliver mission-critical CX through cloud communication solutions. Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale.

Headquartered in Singapore, Toku supports customers across APAC and beyond, with a growing footprint across global markets. As a publicly listed company, Toku continues to scale its presence and impact across international markets.

As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of Toku’s AI and Contact Centre product portfolio. Working closely with the Head of Product, Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders, you’ll turn validated customer problems into scalable platform capabilities, balancing customer needs, technical architecture and commercial outcomes. This is a highly autonomous individual contributor role where you’ll be accountable for product outcomes, customer adoption and the long-term health of the platform—not simply delivering features. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy solving complex technical problems, making data-driven decisions and building products that customers rely on every day.

Requirements

What you will be doing

  • Product Strategy & Delivery: Own the AI and Contact Centre product backlog from discovery through delivery, including customer research, problem validation, PRD creation, prioritisation, agile delivery, product launches and continuous iteration. Base decisions on evidenced customer problems rather than feature requests, while challenging assumptions to deliver the best long-term product outcomes.

  • Platform Product Design: Define scalable, configurable platform capabilities with clean API design, integration contracts and reusable architecture that supports Toku’s contact centre platform, CTI integrations, CRM integrations, developer APIs, partner ecosystems and bring-your-own-model (BYOM) AI integrations.

  • Platform Evolution: Continuously identify opportunities to transform customer-specific implementations into reusable product capabilities, reducing bespoke development and improving scalability across the platform.

  • Product Quality & Measurement: Define meaningful product success metrics covering quality, adoption, accuracy, latency, edit rates, error rates and cost efficiency. Partner with Engineering and data teams to ensure products are properly instrumented and product decisions are driven by live production data rather than demonstrations or assumptions.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering throughout product development while partnering with Sales, Pre-Sales, Professional Services and Delivery teams to ensure products are positioned accurately, enterprise implementations are successful and customer feedback continuously improves the product roadmap.

  • Go-to-Market Support: Support complex customer opportunities by providing product expertise, solution guidance and product positioning that accurately reflects shipped capabilities and platform direction.

  • Continuous Improvement: Champion a product-led culture built around measurable customer outcomes, ensuring roadmap decisions are informed by evidence, customer value and long-term platform sustainability.

  • Ownership: Take full ownership of your product areas, balancing customer needs, technical constraints and commercial priorities while helping shape the future direction of Toku’s AI and customer engagement platform.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • Product Management Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering technical B2B SaaS products, with a strong track record building platform products, APIs, communications platforms (CCaaS, CPaaS or UCaaS), conversational AI, speech technologies or data-driven products.

  • Technical Product Thinking: Strong systems-thinking capability with practical experience discussing API design, integration architectures, platform capabilities and technical trade-offs with senior software engineers.

  • AI Products: Hands-on experience delivering AI or machine learning-powered products into production environments, with a strong understanding of evaluating real-world product quality, reliability and customer outcomes beyond benchmark performance.

  • Product Analytics: Practical experience defining success metrics before development, establishing product instrumentation, interpreting analytics and adapting product direction based on measurable evidence.

  • Platform Architecture: Experience designing configurable, scalable platform capabilities that minimise bespoke development while supporting multiple customer use cases and integrations.

  • Commercial Collaboration: Experience supporting Sales, Pre-Sales and Delivery teams through product positioning, solution design, enterprise customer engagements and successful product deployments.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality product documentation and communicate effectively across Engineering, commercial teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Ownership & Decision Making: Comfortable operating in a scaling business with high autonomy, navigating ambiguity, making informed product decisions and taking ownership of long-term product outcomes.

  • Industry Experience: Experience within regulated industries, public sector organisations, or international markets across APAC, MENA or LATAM would be advantageous.

  • Location: This role can be based in The Netherlands – Hybrid work model, or in wider Europe – remote.

Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC’s Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you’re looking to be part of a company on a strong growth trajectory while working on meaningful, real-world challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

Are you ready to join the forefront of technology innovation with Netcompany?

As one of the fastest growing technology companies, we are disrupting the marketplace and revolutionizing the way businesses operate. Our vision is to be the leading digital challenger in Europe whilst evolving the next generation of IT consulting.

Operating across both public and private sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of services from application development and seamless cloud migration to program delivery and service operations, our offerings are designed to meet diverse business needs

Job Description

MUST HAVE UK PUBLIC SECTOR EXPERIENCE, INCLUDING GDS AND/OR NHS DIGITAL DELIVERY EXPERIENCE, AND CONSULTANCY EXPERIENCE

As a Senior Product Manager at Netcompany you will deliver high profile digital products and services for some of the UK’s largest companies and Public Sector organisations.

You will work with market leading technologies and span user, technical and business operations to build solutions that meet user needs, deliver business  impact and benefit society.

As part of the growing Netcompany Product and User Centred Design practice you are joining at an exciting time and will play an active role in developing Netcompany’s Centres of Excellence and service offerings, support business development and client engagement.

Key Activities:

  • Build strong stakeholder relationships with clients and act as a key point of contact in delivery teams
  • Understand user, business needs and requirements and the wider operational and organisation context
  • Own and develop product strategies and visions
  • Create product roadmaps and prioritise features for development
  • Manage product backlogs including elaboration, prioritisation and acceptance of user stories
  • Create strategies and plans to capture and track user feedback, benefits realisation and service performance and use these to optimise product design
  • Manage supplier performance

Qualifications

  • You are an experienced product manager with the ability to mentor and coach team members to deliver outstanding digital products
  • You work in agile, multi-disciplinary delivery teams and have experience delivering new products as part of large and complex transformation projects
  • You are adept at building strong client relationships and working collaboratively across teams and organisations to deliver challenging projects to tight timescales
  • You have experience delivering in the UK public sector including working to GDS standards and passing Service Standard Assessments
  • Experience in consulting roles is desirable

Additional Information

Benefits:

  • Hybrid working model with some flexible working
  • 25 days’ holiday
  • Private Medical Health care via Vitality
  • Pension contribution, Life Assurance
  • Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
  • A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.
  • Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.

Join Netcompany, where we proudly hold the 5th position on the esteemed UK Top 50 Best Places to Work in the Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Awards for 2024.

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.

Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe’s most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment that celebrates every individual. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email Meena at [email protected] for assistance.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Personalization & AI
jobs.jd_full:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager, Personalization & AI to lead the product vision, strategy, and execution of two interconnected pillars: our next-gen personalization systems (menu ranking, recommendations, search, predictive preferences, and adaptive UI) and a new customer-facing AI experience powered by LLMs.

This role will own both the personalization engine across the entire eater journey and the 0→1 build of a customer-facing AI experience—and will work cross-functionally with ML, LLM engineering, frontend and backend engineering, data science, design, and our culinary teams to build a highly adaptive, intelligent food experience.

You’ll go deep into understanding eater behaviors, intent signals, and food preferences, and translate them into a scalable roadmap across both personalization and conversational AI that meaningfully lifts retention, conversion, and LTV. Our users make hundreds of micro-decisions every week; the goal is to simplify all of them—whether through intelligent ranking or a natural-language experience.

What You’ll Do

Define & Drive Product Strategy

  • Own the end-to-end personalization roadmap including recommendations, ranking algorithms, adaptive feed, intent modeling, and predictive food preferences.
  • Build a unified personalization strategy that spans discovery, ordering, search, and post-order experiences.
  • Translate customer insights and behavioral data into frameworks for “personalized ordering journeys” across weekly menus.

Ship High-Impact Personalization Features

  • Partner with Engineering and ML to design, build, and iterate on models that personalize menus, recommendations, and content surfaces.
  • Launch new ML-powered features—e.g., personalized ranking, contextual suggestion surfaces, food-intent clustering, dietary preference modeling, and personalization-aware UX.
  • Drive experimentation, A/B testing, and offline/online model evaluation frameworks to measure lift rigorously.

Build the Customer-Facing AI Experience (0→1)

  • Own the 0→1 product vision and roadmap for a customer-facing conversational AI experience—from problem definition and early MVP through launch and iteration.
  • Define use cases, conversation flows, and success criteria, balancing eater needs with technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Partner closely with LLM engineering to evaluate models, define grounding strategies, and drive prompt/context architecture decisions from a product lens.
  • Own the full frontend product surface for the AI experience end-to-end, from UX vision through shipped features.
  • Establish evaluation frameworks for LLM product quality—including relevance, hallucination rate, tone, and task completion—and iterate based on real user feedback.

Deeply Understand Customer Behavior

  • Develop a sophisticated understanding of eater behavior patterns, including early-week ordering signals, cuisine preferences, dietary constraints, and long-term engagement drivers.
  • Work closely with Data Science to identify behavioral segments, affinity clusters, and downstream retention impacts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end frontend product surface for the customer-facing AI experience, partnering closely with Design and Engineering from concept through launch.
  • Collaborate on personalization-related frontend surfaces (adaptive homepage, personalized filters, recommendation UI)—contributing product direction while partnering with other PMs and Design who share ownership.
  • Work with Chefs and Culinary to incorporate menu diversity, cuisine metadata, and ingredient-level signals into both personalized and AI-assisted experiences.
  • Collaborate with Growth, CRM, and Marketplace teams to personalize acquisition, onboarding, and reactivation journeys.

Drive Measurable Business Impact

  • Improve core funnel metrics (CVR, add-to-cart rate, search success rate).
  • Lift order retention, order frequency, and net AOV for all eater segments.
  • Increase long-term revenue and reduce decision friction for customers navigating a large menu.

You Are

  • Experienced in ML-powered product development, ranking algorithms, recommendations systems, or personalization platforms.
  • Excited about building 0→1 conversational AI products and comfortable navigating the ambiguity of LLM-powered experiences.
  • Technically grounded in how LLMs work—prompting, RAG, evaluation, guardrails—and able to partner fluently with LLM engineers.
  • Analytical, systems-oriented, and comfortable with experimentation frameworks, model evaluation, and user behavior analytics.
  • A strong frontend product thinker who can own customer-facing UX and translate backend AI capabilities into intuitive, delightful user experiences.
  • Skilled at simplifying complex technical problems into user-centric solutions.
  • Excited by the challenge of turning a large, dynamic food catalog into a highly personalized weekly experience.
  • Collaborative, decisive, and able to partner tightly with Engineering, ML, Design, and cross-functional product groups.
  • Customer-obsessed and eager to understand why users choose the meals they do—and how to anticipate their next choice.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 4+ years working on personalization, search, recommendations, ML/AI products, or similar domains.
  • Experience with LLM-powered products, conversational AI, or chatbot development—hands-on 0→1 experience a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and technical intuition; can work closely with ML/infra teams and reason about relevance, ranking, and experimentation approaches.
  • Proven ability to drive complex products from concept to launch in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms, online metrics, offline model evaluation, and data-driven decision making.
  • Demonstrated ability to own customer-facing frontend product surfaces end-to-end, from UX vision through launch.
  • Strong user experience instincts with a track record of collaborating closely with design.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

Why Join Us

  • Build the core engine behind the future of personalized and AI-powered food experiences.
  • Own a deeply impactful part of the product that directly influences customer happiness and long-term retention.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, data scientists, designers, and chefs.
  • Work in a fast-growing, chef-driven marketplace experiencing rapid expansion across the U.S. and Canada.
  • Competitive compensation, equity package, and benefits.

Benefits

🩺  Health Insurance coverage

🌅 401k Plan

⛱ Unlimited PTO

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🥘 A generous amount of CookUnity credits to enjoy our amazing meals, added to your account, monthly

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Wellness perks: access to fitness subsidies to build a healthy lifestyle

👩🏾‍🏫 Personalized Spanish coach

🚀 Awesome opportunity to join a company that is looking to change how we eat and how chefs work!

Compensation

All final pay rates will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Pay Range for this position

$150,000—$180,000 USD

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we’ll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels.All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify.You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels.That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details.If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Position Summary:

With team members and customers in 39 countries around the globe, HostPapa is currently one of the fastest-growing web hosting companies with a wide range of products available. At its core, we provide individuals and small and medium-sized businesses with access to valuable tools and services critical to their online success, including a Website Builder service for making website creation an ultra-easy task for anyone. Tailored to meet every user’s unique needs, our award-winning customer support, email, and cloud-based solutions keep HostPapa at the cutting edge of the web hosting industry and innovation by putting our customers first.

This role focuses on CloudBlue, a HostPapa business that powers cloud commerce for many of the world’s largest service providers, including major Telcos, distributors, and MSPs. CloudBlue enables partners to monetize and manage cloud services and subscriptions at scale, combining the agility of a high-growth business with the backing of a global organization.

As the Senior Technical Product Manager, you will play a key role in defining market needs, shaping solutions, and driving the evolution of the CloudBlue platform. You will connect customer problems, product strategy, and AI-driven innovation into scalable solutions within a microservices-based, cloud-native SaaS environment. Working within a fully remote and international team, you will help deliver impactful product capabilities that align with business goals while enhancing customer and partner experiences.

What you’ll do

  • Define and drive the product vision and strategy aligned with CloudBlue’s business goals, partners, and customers
  • Research, validate, and translate market needs into product opportunities and roadmap initiatives
  • Plan and prioritize product roadmap deliverables, aligning releases with business impact and strategic priorities
  • Define solutions through clear product requirements, user stories, and documentation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions and ensure strong go-to-market execution
  • Support adoption of product features by working closely with internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams
  • Continuously explore and evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-driven capabilities, to enhance the platform
  • Support other tasks or projects as assigned to meet team and business needs

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in product management within a relevant technology domain (experience in solution or software architecture is also valuable)
  • Strong experience scoping and validating complex customer requirements
  • Ability to operate effectively at different levels of detail depending on context and audience
  • Solid understanding of software design, development, testing, and delivery, including APIs and system interactions
  • Experience in domains such as Billing, BSS, ERP, Finance, eCommerce, or AI-driven solutions with large customer bases is required
  • Practical experience applying AI-first workflows to product management and day-to-day processes
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, planning, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure services (Kubernetes, databases, and storage across AWS, Azure, or GCP) would be beneficial
  • Familiarity with development technologies such as Python, Go, SQL, or similar tools is an added advantage

What we offer:

  • This is a remote opportunity, open to candidates located within the European Union only, in line with team needs and operational requirements
  • A competitive salary that values you and your unique skill sets
  • Career advancement & professional development opportunities to help you reach your full potential
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work/life balance

About us:

At HostPapa, we’ve been committed to providing a complete array of enterprise-grade cloud services solutions to every business owner since 2006. These services, traditionally out of reach to smaller businesses, are offered in a one-stop shop, making it quick and easy for customers to select the services they need to grow. We back these offerings with 24⁄7 award‑winning customer support in four languages.

Our HostPapa team values diversity and inclusion. We have a friendly company culture built on trust and respect. With the acquisition of several companies into our product portfolio, we’re growing at an incredible rate and have ample opportunities for career growth.

Come join our talented team of enthusiastic, hard-working, passionate, driven people engaged in meaningful, innovative work. We can’t wait to meet you!

HostPapa is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of our diverse team.

HostPapa is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. Accommodation may be provided in all parts ofthe hiring process.

It is anticipated that this position will be performed outside of Ontario.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Studio Team
jobs.jd_full:
About GameChanger:

We believe in the life changing impact youth sports have on and off the field. Sports encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence – important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.

So if you love sports and their community building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

The Position:

GameChanger is launching a Studio team, a small, fast-moving group whose job is to answer one question: is this opportunity worth pursuing? Partnering with our Strategy team, the Studio takes new and emerging business ideas, like expanding into a new sport or entering an international market, and rapidly validates them with real customers. This lets us commit to the right bets faster and stop sitting on promising ideas because we lack evidence.

As the founding product manager on this team, you’ll pair with a designer to run focused validation sprints. Unlike a traditional product management role, your output isn’t a shipped feature or a roadmap of releases. It’s confidence: a clear, evidence-backed recommendation on whether an opportunity deserves deeper investment and handoff to a product team, or whether we should walk away and move on to the next idea. You’ll operate more like a founder than a feature owner, with no large embedded team behind you, pulling in partners from User Research, Strategy, Data & Analytics, Product, Engineering, and beyond when the work demands it. You will report directly to our SVP of Product.

What You’ll Do:

Opportunity framing: Partner with the Strategy team to translate emerging business ideas into sharp, testable hypotheses. Define the riskiest assumptions, what “validated” looks like, and what evidence would change our minds before any work begins.

Validation sprints: Run the Studio’s operating cadence with your design partner. Scope each sprint tightly, choose the fastest credible path to an answer, and keep the team moving instead of polishing.

Market and business analysis: Size opportunities, model potential business cases, analyze competitive and market dynamics, and pressure-test whether an idea can work commercially, not just whether customers like it.

Customer evidence: Get in front of real coaches, players, families, and prospective customers alongside your designer, whether that means surveys, interviews, onsite ethnographic research, demand tests, or prototypes in market.

Recommendations: Synthesize customer evidence and business analysis into crisp go/no-go recommendations for leadership, including the honest recommendation to not pursue something. Package validated opportunities for a smooth handoff to a product team to build.

Team building: Help define how the Studio operates. As a founding member, you’ll shape the playbook, the sprint cadence, the decision framework, and the standard for what “enough confidence” means.

Leverage AI: Use AI tools aggressively across research synthesis, analysis, and prototyping support so a two-person team can evaluate far more than its size suggests.

Who You Are:

jobs.title: Product Manager, Learning Platforms & Impact
jobs.jd_full:
Product Manager, Learning Platforms & Impact

GENERATION CITIZEN

Location: Remote

ABOUT US

Generation Citizen offers tools for the rising generation to build civic skills and make America the inclusive, multi-racial democracy that we need. We are transforming how civics is taught by providing equity-rooted, real-world civic education that helps students understand how governments function and how they can make a difference in the system. Through hands-on civic education, legislative advocacy, coalition-building, and youth leadership development, we teach young people to have a voice and become active citizens in their communities.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a mission-driven Product Manager to lead the build and evolution of our learning technology ecosystem. You will serve as the strategic bridge between our civic education mission and the platform infrastructure that supports thousands of educators, ensuring our digital tools actively enhance teachers’ ability to facilitate student engagement and strengthen student outcomes and teacher skills.

As an effective relationship builder, you will ensure our products support an exceptional learner experience and robust content strategy. You will collaborate cross-functionally with instructional content designers and other national/regional teams to deploy high-quality training and impactful learning management solutions.

This position reports directly to the Chief Strategy Officer and partners closely with the Chief Operating Officer. While positions are currently remote or hybrid, all staff members are expected to travel overnight at least once per year for staff retreats and other team gatherings.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform & Product Ownership

  • Own the comprehensive Docebo architecture, shaping the digital experience of teacher learning to maximize user experience and engagement, and maintaining overall UX standards to resolve technical and programmatic inconsistencies.
  • Develop and own all internal workflows to support the internalization of product experiences and connectivity to additional systems (ex., Tableau, Google, Salesforce)
  • Manage the learning product feature roadmap, shifting the organization from a reactive approach to using our strategic plan as a guide and drawing on user feedback and insights.
  • Lead and maintain system integrations to ensure workflows do not break at scale.
  • Conduct ongoing audits of platform processes to identify operational bottlenecks, and actively recommend and implement system optimizations that reduce administrative burden and improve our ‘cost to serve’ metrics while optimizing the learning journey.

Data & Evaluation Integration

  • Translate teacher engagement and course completion data into actionable insights for district partners and internal program teams to demonstrate impact.
  • Align curriculum and e-learning course data directly with broader organization-wide impact measures.
  • Build shared dashboards and reporting from Docebo into insights for the Program & Impact team.
  • Develop and deliver internal training initiatives to increase organizational ‘data literacy,’ empowering non-technical staff to independently access and interpret LMS data to inform their own work.

Cross-Team Governance & Communication

  • Co-design learning pathways alongside the Director of Instructional Design to ensure asynchronous learning modules respect teachers’ limited prep time while delivering high-impact civic pedagogy.
  • Establish and maintain comprehensive documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all LMS workflows, ensuring that platform processes are transparent, replicable, and resilient to staff turnover.
  • Run strategic learning systems meetings, set standard operating platform policies, and resolve technical tradeoffs.
  • Proactively identify and address potential cross-functional friction points; lead the communication infrastructure for complex projects, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned before, during, and after implementation phases.

Role Boundaries & Scope Notes:

  • This role is not the primary curriculum designer.
  • This role is not responsible for frontline daily operations support or lead evaluation tasks.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Demonstrated experience in the K-12 or education technology space, with a deep understanding of how to translate pedagogical goals into intuitive, user-centered digital experiences.
  • 2+ years of product management experience overseeing learning management systems (LMS) or edtech platforms designed specifically for K-12 educators or youth development.
  • Demonstrated expertise in managing product roadmaps, handling complex third-party software integrations, and establishing UX consistency.
  • Strong capacity to translate evaluation questions into software metrics, configure dashboards, and maintain unsiloed data pipelines.
  • Exceptional relationship management and change management skills necessary to run cross-team governance and train diverse internal groups.
  • Strong project and portfolio management skills, with a track record of managing competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Experience navigating organizational change, including managing stakeholder resistance, building cross-departmental alignment, and translating strategic priorities into practice
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau or comparable data visualization tools, and Qualtrics or similar survey platforms.

NOTE

This position works primarily remotely but will be expected to travel no more than 30% of the time to attend monthly in-person team days, organizational retreats, special events, external partner meetings, conferences, and other potential in-person activities. Required in-person opportunities include, but are not limited to, annual staff retreats, funder meetings, school visits, and region-based Civics Day events. This role may include a limited amount of overnight travel.

HOW TO APPLY

Complete the applicationand be sure to attach a resume and cover letter. A recruiter will reach out to qualified candidates to schedule a phone screen. While the hiring timeline is subject to change, the GC team hopes to have the Product Manager role on the National Program and Impact team filled by or before October 1, 2026.Thank you for your interest in joining our team at Generation Citizen. We look forward to reviewing your application! We encourage applicants to submit their applications early.

SALARY

Generation Citizen is committed to maintaining a compensation and total rewards package that supports our ability to recruit and retain a diverse and talented team. As we make decisions about compensation, we are guided by the following values: clarity, consistency, and internal pay equity. Roles on the National team extend throughout the country causing a wider salary range due to geographic variation versus regional roles that have a set salary.

The salary range for this role is $66,120 to $72,898.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are values that Generation Citizen is committed to upholding across our business operations. To accomplish our purpose of Generation Citizen, we think it takes a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this position, and we welcome their applications.

GC’S CORE VALUES

Our best benefit of all? The opportunity to work alongside smart, passionate colleagues who are working to rebuild our democracy in alignment with our core values of grassroots change, systemic impact, collaboration and diversity, action, and open-mindedness.

VACATION TIME, PTO & PAID HOLIDAYS

Generation Citizen offers unlimited PTO, a set of paid holidays, and a fully-paid winter break that happens from December 24th through January 2nd of each year.

MEDICAL, DENTAL & VISION BENEFITS

GC offers all full-time employees medical, dental, and vision benefits through a co-employment relationship with Emplova, a professional employer organization (PEO). Emplova provides five competitive Cigna medical plans for employees to choose from, as well as vision and dental plans with MetLife. All medical, dental, and vision benefits are effective the 1st day of the month after an employee’s start date. GC subsidizes up to 80% for employees and 65% for their dependents, based on the selected plan.

ANCILLARY BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Laptop computer
  • Monthly $100 Work-from-Home stipend
  • $150 Work-from-Home set-up reimbursement
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Savings Account
  • 401(k) with a 3% employer match (capped at $1,000 annually)
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) through Emplova Health Advocate
  • Tickets at Work
  • Pet Insurance

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II
jobs.jd_full:
WHO WE ARE

ActBlue is a nonprofit organization dedicated to creating cutting-edge technology that fuels Democratic victories and enables progressive causes to thrive.

Our vision is simple: building change through the power of people. Since our founding, we’ve been building innovative solutions to revolutionize grassroots fundraising – if you’ve donated to a Democratic campaign or a progressive organization online, you’ve probably used our platform! We believe in putting power in the hands of small-dollar donors by helping thousands of groups — from local candidates to national movements — mobilize their communities and create a lasting impact. Every member of our team is deeply committed to advancing our shared mission and core values. Together, we are shaping the future of democracy.

THE OPPORTUNITY

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Here’s the list tailored to a Senior PM role owning adoption growth, product discovery, and onboarding at ActBlue:

  • Owns the end-to-end strategy for product adoption across the platform, setting the roadmap-level priorities that determine how campaigns and nonprofits discover, onboard onto, and succeed with ActBlue’s tools.

  • Applies strong analytical skills to synthesize qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, support tickets, usage data, and market analysis, translating findings into clear, actionable product decisions that drive adoption.
  • Delivers product requirements, release plans, and long-term roadmaps for onboarding and adoption workstreams in alignment with ActBlue’s broader product and organizational strategy.
  • Leads discussions on org-wide priorities, tradeoffs, and dependencies to ship product discovery, adoption and onboarding improvements that move the needle for campaigns’ and nonprofits’ fundraising success.
  • Weighs the short- and long-term impact of adoption and onboarding decisions on users, ActBlue, and the fundraising ecosystem, ensuring choices align with the product vision.
  • Creates well-organized documentation for complex cross-team initiatives, including strategy briefs, requirements, and rollout plans.
  • Tailors communication of adoption metrics, onboarding insights, and growth strategy to the needs of engineering, design, support, leadership, and other stakeholders.
  • Frames the problem, ROI, constraints, and possible solutions for improving campaign and nonprofit success on the platform
  • Builds strong relationships with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, support, data, marketing) to drive alignment on how to grow product adoption
  • Recognized as an expert in product adoption, onboarding, and growth strategy, with strong working knowledge of the broader ActBlue product and technology stack.
  • Drives research into adoption and onboarding performance, using data analysis, competitive analysis, and user research to inform product direction and prioritization.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5-7 years of demonstrable experience in product management with a track record of driving user adoption or growth

  • Strong strategic mindset and the ability to drive long-term strategy while effectively managing and prioritizing the execution details of ongoing projects on your team
  • Comfortable moving fast and iterating, using experimentation (A/B tests, pilots, phased rollouts) to validate what actually drives adoption rather than relying on assumption or intuition alone.
  • Skilled at tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience working in a nimble product delivery organization where product, design, and engineering work in close collaboration
  • Strong communication skills with a team-centric and remote-reliant approach to discussion and collaboration, with the ability to navigate tough conversations and strive for desirable outcomes for all participants
  • Attention to detail for the design and usability of our customer experiences and empathy for our users’ needs
  • Experience making product decisions through data-driven measurements and user research; competency in using SQL, Looker, or other data-visualization tools is a plus
  • A strong desire for fostering inclusivity and belonging among your coworkers
  • Interest in progressive politics

WORK & BENEFITS SNAPSHOT

This posting is for a full-time, remote, salaried position. Travel may be required on a limited basis to attend all-staff and departmental retreats (1-2 times per year). Additional travel may be required for select positions.

Registered States*:

Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington D.C.

* While ActBlue is currently registered to support remote work in the states listed above, we possess the ability to register in additional states as needed. If you are located in a state not listed, we may still be able to proceed with your application, but please note that the offer process may take longer to accommodate registration requirements.

Work Schedule: This role requires availability during established, regular business hours (Mon-Fri).

Work Environment: Employees can expect to work with distributed teams across all U.S. time zones. Our roles require extended technology usage, and proficiency with virtual communication tools such as Zoom and Slack. Regular attendance in virtual meetings is inherent to every position.

Salary Range Details: $162,027 - $178,971 - $195,915

ActBlue is committed to consistent compensation practices across our organization. Final salary offers will take into account factors such as candidate experience, interview performance and current team salary parity.

Benefits:

  • Flexible work schedules and an unlimited time-off policy
  • Fully paid and trans-inclusive health, dental, and vision insurance for employees and their families; plus fully-paid health reimbursement arrangement to use for out of pocket expenses and fully-paid short- and long-term disability
  • Fully paid basic and AD&D life insurance and a voluntary supplemental life insurance option

ActBlue is unable to sponsor work visas at this time.

UNION INFORMATION

BACKGROUND CHECKS

As part of our hiring process, ActBlue will conduct a background check at the time of offer. This will be completed in compliance with applicable laws and will not be initiated without your consent.

INCLUSION STATEMENT FROM ACTBLUE

ActBlue is committed to equal employment opportunities and fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace. We celebrate unique perspectives, honor the dignity of all individuals, and recognize that diverse backgrounds and identities strengthen our mission.

If you’re passionate about our work and see yourself in this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

  • Strategic vision and influence: Own the strategic ‘north star’ of your product, author and communicate a clear narrative around this vision, and gain buy-in from all levels of NEC and beyond using compelling evidence and insight.

  • Product growth. Deliver ambitious roadmaps that grow market share and enter new markets (public / private / international).

  • Product, tech, market, & competitor research. Act as a domain SME, staying ahead of market and technology trends, as well as analysing our competitors. You will maintain the associated collateral including documenting our relative position in the market, potential partnerships and growth opportunities.

  • Go‑to‑market execution. Lead go‑to‑market planning and execution for new products and features, orchestrating cross‑functional teams and owning outcomes.

  • Product ownership. End‑to‑end ownership of the product lifecycle, balancing system health, delivery commitments and innovation, while owning the value narrative behind decisions supported by commercial and market insight.

  • Iterative value delivery. Break down initiatives into small, frequently releasable increments of value - assessing outcomes with customers and stakeholders throughout delivery.

  • Voice of the customer. Build trusted customer/user relationships and represent customer needs and preferences within the wider product team.

  • User‑centred design. Apply design‑thinking, mapping and tracking end‑to‑end user, patient, and customer journeys, to improve user and patient experience - collaborating with design, clinical and other cross-functional teams. Organise and lead customer & user engagement/feedback sessions (individual and group).

  • Measuring success. Define and track product key performance indicators (KPIs) aligned to your business unit’s objectives and key results (OKRs), owning the sourcing of data where gaps exist.

  • Third‑party collaboration. Work with technical teams to assess third‑party solutions, ensuring value for money and strategic fit.

Operations & Communication:

  • Product backlog. Own and manage/prioritise the product backlog, balancing system health, delivery commitments and incremental value – able to build clear narratives explaining your decisions that gain buy-in. You will maintain a minimal amount of ‘ready’ work within your backlog to keep your team forever busy.

  • Demand management & requirements gathering/documentation. Own the new demand funnel into your team, as well as the prioritisation of new working coming into your team and be accountable for the quality and sign off requirements & user story documentation – collaborating with the wider product team to define and meet acceptance criteria and ‘ready’/‘done’ standards.

  • Quality products, on time. Accountable for value delivered to customers, working with technical leads to ensure scalable, quality, interoperable solutions are delivered on time, whilst coordinating releases and associated communications.

  • Release coordination. Coordinate releases and associated communications to ensure clarity and readiness for customers and stakeholders.

  • Stakeholder/customer management. Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders/customers – including using proactive, clear, and personalised communication.

  • Team ways of working. Work with development leaders to maintain effective team RACI and strive to continuously improve delivery predictability, quality, efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Product collateral. Create and maintain all product collateral necessary to enable comms, sales, marketing and the implementation teams to be successful.

Propositions, sales and commercial acumen:

  • Propositions. Deeply understand where your product sits within your market as well as the NEC Health ecosystem – constantly looking for collaboration (internally and externally) and scaled value opportunities.

  • Product ROI. Track and strive to forever improve the return on investment of your product team - working closely with finance and sales to track current and projected revenues and costs, whilst remaining ambitious in terms of growth.

  • Business cases. Author business cases to gain buy-in from an exec audience that are compelling from a proposition, commercial, architectural and product strategy perspective.

  • Sales enablement. Act as product SME and advocate, supporting sales with collateral, training and provide direct support in pitches when required.

  • Third‑party management. Assess the use of third‑parties for use for your product, negotiate on cost/features where appropriate, and explore alternatives alongside the technical teams.

Soft skills and personal characteristics:

  • Exceptional communicator and presenter (written, in person, and online).

  • Self-starter and autonomous worker.

  • User / customer obsessed.

  • Problem solver / option creator.

  • Exceptional time management and organisational skills.

  • Adaptable and resilient to an ever-changing landscape.

Advantageous experience

  • Proven SaaS product manager with demonstrable value delivered.

  • Delivered AI/data products.

  • Working with AI to improve your efficiency and working with an AI enabled development team.

  • Experience across agile, scaled agile and waterfall delivery.

  • Healthcare sector.

  • Familiarity with product management tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Jira, Aha!).

  • Scaled a product internationally.

Location

  • This is a remote role with the expectation to travel to customer sites and NEC offices across the country when required.

Qualifications

No particular qualifications are mandatory, although degree level+ or equivalent certifications in a product, project management, business or technical related disciplines would be advantageous.

Additional Information

We are proud of the benefits we offer employees of NEC Software Solutions

  • Private Medical Cover funded by NEC for Employees (with the option to add family members at an additional cost)
  • 25 days paid holiday with the option to buy/ sell
  • 4 x basic salary life assurance cover funded by NEC (with the option to increase cover at an additional cost)
  • A Group Pension Plan with fantastic employer contributions up to a maximum of 8.5%
  • A fantastic selection of flexible benefits to suit your individual needs
  • We are an employer who cares, we have a invaluable employee assistance programme which can help in every area of your life
  • All colleagues get free access to LinkedIn Learning. Over 15000 courses covering a huge breadth of subjects. Learn about what you like, when you like, how you like.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. Documentary evidence will be required.

All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting and reference checks. This role will require UK Security Clearance.

NEC Software Solutions is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applications from all communities. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have specific accessibility needs during the recruitment or interview process, please feel free to share these with us. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accommodating experience for all candidates.

Who We Are:

We’re NEC Software Solutions (part of global tech giant NEC Corporation). While you read this ad, our software is helping to dispatch ambulances, support families, keep trains on the move, locate missing people and even test the hearing of newborn babies.

Working with us, you’ll be helping our 3,000+ employees push the boundaries of what’s possible and support amazing public services.

We work with governments, hospitals, police forces, housing providers, local authorities and more. We help them pay financial support faster, speed up treatments for patients and respond to emergencies in the right way. The more we do, the more our customers can do for others. And together, we make a world of difference.

We’d love your help. And we’ll support you all the way.
